decision: Accept the platform-safe input artifact split
reasons: RPi3 does not probe QEMU-only VirtIO MMIO
default QEMU builds retain direct VirtIO probing
RPi3 target and embedded outputs are isolated from generic AArch64 outputs
the build fails closed instead of packaging a stale input binary
the exact real-board fault did not recur
remainingLimits: This proves the ARM64 boot and runtime regression lane, not full G1 device coverage
UART trace-marker noise remains outside this fix
persistent SD-backed volumes remain outside this netboot lane
